# Plus7z v0.3.0

Plus7z now uses Cardo v0.3.0 for its desktop application shell.

- Shared panels, controls, titlebar, native dialog lifecycle and draggable three-second notifications.
- Dialog inputs are created in their destination window; close reasons and stale callbacks are handled by the shared host.
- Shared task cancellation/delivery, settings snapshots and shortcut infrastructure.
- Event-driven single-instance launches, native file pickers and independent system icon data.
- Configurable update mechanics upstream; package whitelist, SQLite journal and registry/install policy remain in Plus7z.
- Application startup uses Cardo services; the independent Cardo Desk template demonstrates reuse without Plus7z sources or assets.
- Updated English/Chinese architecture and verification documentation, MIT and dependency notices.

Product package/crate names remain `p7z` / `p7z-*`. Existing `%LOCALAPPDATA%\p7z` paths, TOML/SQLite formats and UI layout are retained. No compatibility import or schema migration is added. The purple Cardo cube and Plus7z artwork remain unchanged.

Windows x64 packages include the pinned 7-Zip 26.03 engine and Visual C++ runtime. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains package checksums. Full 7-Zip File Manager parity remains incomplete; see the README scope and `docs/verification-v0.3.0.md` for actual runtime coverage and unverified update/UI scenarios.
